title.ja: 海外の同僚に自己紹介
title.en: Introducing yourself to an overseas colleague

summary.ja: 名前と仕事を紹介して、相手のことも聞き、次の約束をする。
summary.en: Introduce yourself and your job, ask about theirs, and make a plan to talk again.

setting: The first day of a joint project. You meet a colleague from the London office at the start of an online meeting, a few minutes before it begins.

roles.persona: A member of the Tokyo team meeting a colleague for the first time.

levels.tutor: You are Sam, a friendly colleague from the London office. Speak slowly and simply. Introduce yourself first, then ask the student's name and job.

hints: 名前を伝えましょう
I'm … Nice to …
Hi, I'm Kenji. Nice to meet you.
自分の仕事を伝えましょう
I work in …
I work in sales.
相手のことを聞きましょう
How long have you …?
How long have you worked in London?

levels.tutor: You are Sam from the London office, speaking at natural pace. Be friendly, talk a little about your role in the project, and react to what the student says.

hints: 名前と部署を伝えましょう
I'm … from the … team.
I'm Kenji from the sales team in Tokyo.

title.ja: 担当している仕事を説明する

hints: 担当している仕事を説明しましょう
I'm in charge of …
I'm in charge of our clients in Asia.

title.ja: 相手について質問する

hints: 相手の仕事について聞きましょう
What are you working on …?
What are you working on at the moment?
また話そうと伝えましょう
Let's … sometime.
Let's have a call sometime next week.

levels.tutor: You are Sam from the London office, speaking at natural speed with small talk (the weather, the time difference). Mention you're under pressure with a deadline.

title.ja: 自己紹介と役割を伝える

hints: 名前と役割をまとめて伝えましょう
I'm …, and I'll be …
I'm Kenji, and I'll be handling the Asian market for this project.
時差や天気について話しましょう
It must be … there now.
It must be early morning there now.
困ったら声をかけてと伝えましょう
If you need …, just …
If you need anything from Tokyo, just let me know.

title.ja: 具体的な次の予定を決める
title.en: Fix a time to talk again

hints: 次の打ち合わせの日時を提案しましょう
How about … at …?
How about Thursday at 5 p.m. your time?

roles.persona: Sam, a colleague in the London office.

levels.tutor: You are Kenji from the Tokyo team, meeting Sam for the first time. Speak slowly and simply and let Sam lead.

title.ja: あいさつして名前を言う
title.en: Greet them and say your name

hints: あいさつして名前を言いましょう
Hi, I'm … Nice to …
Hi, I'm Sam. Nice to meet you.
相手の仕事を聞きましょう
What do you …?
What do you do?
反応して、もう一言つなげましょう
Oh, that's … I …
Oh, that's interesting. I work in marketing.

levels.tutor: You are Kenji from the Tokyo team, speaking at natural pace.

hints: 歓迎の言葉を伝えましょう
Welcome to …
Welcome to the project! I'm Sam from London.
相手の役割を聞きましょう
What will you be …?
What will you be working on?
時差について話しましょう
What time is it …?
What time is it in Tokyo now?
次の予定を提案しましょう
Shall we …?
Shall we set up a call for next week?

levels.tutor: You are Kenji from the Tokyo team, speaking at natural speed. You're keen but a little worried about the deadline.

title.ja: 歓迎してプロジェクトを紹介する
title.en: Welcome them and introduce the project

hints: 歓迎してプロジェクトについて一言話しましょう
Great to have you … We're …
Great to have you on board. We're launching in March.

title.en: Ask about their role and experience

hints: 経験について聞きましょう
Have you worked on … before?
Have you worked on a launch like this before?
心配しないでと伝えましょう
Don't worry, we'll …
Don't worry, we'll go through the plan together.

title.ja: 具体的な次の予定を決める
title.en: Fix a time to talk again

hints: 日時を決めましょう
Does … work for you?
Does Thursday at 9 a.m. Tokyo time work for you?
